question: Which is a circular basin covering an area of 5.427 million square miles surrounded by North America and Eurasia?
solution:
The correct answer is the **Arctic** **Ocean.** [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• **Arctic Ocean**:

 
 
• Location: Surrounded by North America and Eurasia.
 
• Size: The smallest and shallowest of the world's oceans, covering an area of about 5.427 million square miles.
 
• Deepest Point: The Eurasian Basin's Fram Basin has the deepest point, known as the Fram Strait.
 
 
 
• **Other Oceans**:
 
 
• **Indian Ocean**:
 
 
• Location: Bounded by Africa, Asia, Australia, and the Indian subcontinent.
 
• Size: The third-largest ocean.
 
• Deepest Point: **The Sunda Trench.**
 
 
 
• **Atlantic Ocean**:
 
 
• Location: Between the Americas to the west and Europe and Africa to the east.
 
• Size: The second-largest ocean.
 
• Deepest Point: The Puerto Rico Trench.
 
 
 
• **Pacific Ocean**:
 
 
• Location: The largest and deepest ocean, covering the western coasts of the Americas to the eastern coasts of Asia and Australia.
 
• Size: The largest ocean.
 
• Deepest Point: The Challenger Deep in the Mariana Trench.
 
 
 
 

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• **Where Oceans Meet**:

 
 
• The Arctic Ocean connects with the Atlantic Ocean through the Greenland Sea and the Norwegian Sea.
 
• The Atlantic, Indian, and Southern Oceans are interconnected.
 
• The Pacific Ocean connects with the other oceans through various straits and passages.
